'''Ran-D housekeeper droids''' were hovering [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that maintained living spaces.

A few were visible floating in [[Mama/Legends|Mama's]] [[Mama the Hutt's house/Legends|house]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and some could be seen working in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ran-D housekeeper droids are an homage to the flying robots of [[Industrial Light & Magic]]'s [[1987]] film [[Wikipedia:*batteries not included|''*batteries not included'']].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>
